catalog.label: No mixing valve
catalog.description: Everything the pump makes reaches the emitters; the tank is a pass-through with a standing loss.
catalog.requirement: no throttling mixing valve configured

catalog.label: One tank behind a valve
catalog.description: The valve regulates one shared flow to every circuit; wood heat, if any, is folded into the heat-pump tank.
catalog.requirement: a throttling mixing valve

catalog.label: Two tanks, one 4-way valve
catalog.description: A wood tank beside the heat-pump tank; the valve draws wood-first while usable and feeds both floors in parallel.
catalog.requirement: a throttling valve, two zones and a wood-tank top probe

catalog.label: Valve on the radiators, slab fed direct
catalog.description: Only the radiator circuit sits behind the valve; the slab drinks raw tank water.
catalog.requirement: a throttling valve, two zones, and no wood-tank probe (no model exists for two tanks with a direct-fed slab)

catalog.label: Separate slab shunt
catalog.description: A second shunt on the slab circuit. Recorded as a known layout; not selectable until physics exists for it.
catalog.requirement: not selectable: no model variant exists yet

catalog.label: Kein Mischventil
catalog.description: Alles, was die Pumpe erzeugt, erreicht die Heizflächen; der Speicher ist nur ein Durchlauf mit Standverlust.
catalog.requirement: kein drosselndes Mischventil konfiguriert

catalog.label: Ein Speicher hinter einem Ventil
catalog.description: Das Ventil regelt einen gemeinsamen Vorlauf für alle Kreise; Holzwärme wird, falls vorhanden, im Wärmepumpenspeicher mitgerechnet.
catalog.requirement: ein drosselndes Mischventil

catalog.label: Zwei Speicher, ein 4-Wege-Ventil
catalog.description: Ein Holzspeicher neben dem Wärmepumpenspeicher; das Ventil nimmt zuerst Holzwärme, solange sie nutzbar ist, und versorgt beide Etagen parallel.
catalog.requirement: ein drosselndes Ventil, zwei Zonen und ein Fühler oben am Holzspeicher

catalog.label: Ventil am Heizkörperkreis, Estrich direkt versorgt
catalog.description: Nur der Heizkörperkreis liegt hinter dem Ventil; der Estrich bezieht ungemischtes Speicherwasser.
catalog.requirement: ein drosselndes Ventil, zwei Zonen und kein Holzspeicher-Fühler (es gibt kein Modell für zwei Speicher mit direkt versorgtem Estrich)

catalog.label: No mixing valve
catalog.description: Everything the pump makes reaches the emitters; the tank is a pass-through with a standing loss.
catalog.requirement: no throttling mixing valve configured

catalog.label: One tank behind a valve
catalog.description: The valve regulates one shared flow to every circuit; wood heat, if any, is folded into the heat-pump tank.
catalog.requirement: a throttling mixing valve

catalog.label: Two tanks, one 4-way valve
catalog.description: A wood tank beside the heat-pump tank; the valve draws wood-first while usable and feeds both floors in parallel.
catalog.requirement: a throttling valve, two zones and a wood-tank top probe

catalog.label: Valve on the radiators, slab fed direct
catalog.description: Only the radiator circuit sits behind the valve; the slab drinks raw tank water.
catalog.requirement: a throttling valve, two zones, and no wood-tank probe (no model exists for two tanks with a direct-fed slab)

catalog.label: Separate slab shunt
catalog.description: A second shunt on the slab circuit. Recorded as a known layout; not selectable until physics exists for it.
catalog.requirement: not selectable: no model variant exists yet

catalog.label: No mixing valve

catalog.label: One tank behind a valve
catalog.description: The valve regulates one shared flow to every circuit; wood heat, if any, is folded into the heat-pump tank.
catalog.requirement: a throttling mixing valve

catalog.label: Two tanks, one 4-way valve
catalog.description: A wood tank beside the heat-pump tank; the valve draws wood-first while usable and feeds both floors in parallel.
catalog.requirement: a throttling valve, two zones and a wood-tank top probe

catalog.label: Valve on the radiators, slab fed direct
catalog.description: Only the radiator circuit sits behind the valve; the slab drinks raw tank water.
catalog.requirement: a throttling valve, two zones, and no wood-tank probe (no model exists for two tanks with a direct-fed slab)

catalog.label: Separate slab shunt
catalog.description: A second shunt on the slab circuit. Recorded as a known layout; not selectable until physics exists for it.
catalog.requirement: not selectable: no model variant exists yet

catalog.requirement: no throttling mixing valve configured

catalog.label: One tank behind a valve
catalog.description: The valve regulates one shared flow to every circuit; wood heat, if any, is folded into the heat-pump tank.
catalog.requirement: a throttling mixing valve

catalog.label: Two tanks, one 4-way valve
catalog.description: A wood tank beside the heat-pump tank; the valve draws wood-first while usable and feeds both floors in parallel.
catalog.requirement: a throttling valve, two zones and a wood-tank top probe

catalog.label: Valve on the radiators, slab fed direct
catalog.description: Only the radiator circuit sits behind the valve; the slab drinks raw tank water.
catalog.requirement: a throttling valve, two zones, and no wood-tank probe (no model exists for two tanks with a direct-fed slab)

catalog.label: Separate slab shunt
catalog.description: A second shunt on the slab circuit. Recorded as a known layout; not selectable until physics exists for it.
catalog.requirement: not selectable: no model variant exists yet

catalog.label: No mixing valve
catalog.description: Everything the pump makes reaches the emitters; the tank is a pass-through with a standing loss.
catalog.requirement: no throttling mixing valve configured

catalog.label: One tank behind a valve
catalog.description: The valve regulates one shared flow to every circuit; wood heat, if any, is folded into the heat-pump tank.
catalog.requirement: a throttling mixing valve

catalog.label: Two tanks, one 4-way valve
catalog.description: A wood tank beside the heat-pump tank; the valve draws wood-first while usable and feeds both floors in parallel.
catalog.requirement: a throttling valve, two zones and a wood-tank top probe

catalog.label: Valve on the radiators, slab fed direct
catalog.description: Only the radiator circuit sits behind the valve; the slab drinks raw tank water.
catalog.requirement: a throttling valve, two zones, and no wood-tank probe (no model exists for two tanks with a direct-fed slab)

catalog.label: Separate slab shunt
catalog.description: A second shunt on the slab circuit. Recorded as a known layout; not selectable until physics exists for it.
catalog.requirement: not selectable: no model variant exists yet
